'''Qogo''' was an amber clouded [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] and twin of [[Uluq]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] and shared the same [[Star system/Legends|system]] as [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Transitory Mists]].<ref name="Invincible" /> [[Uroro Station]] was once built between Qogo and Uluq to serve as a transfer station for [[Hapan]] ships traveling along [[the Throat]] to the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world of Shedu Maad.<ref name="TCSWE2">{{CSWECite|III|283|Uroro Station}}</ref>
